Name: Howa's Nyapu-Style Isla NPC
Author: Howaa
Description:
I created some quick Nyapu-style Isla portraits, using Nyapu's Emily sprites as reference - I haven't played with Isla yet but wanted to have consistent portraits for my game - I may return and tweak some of her expressions if I think the current sprites are too bubbly/don't match her personality! Future updates may also include drawing portraits for the other characters in the mod.

To install, you will need to drop the files into your Isla Mod folder to manually overwrite the portrait sprites.

Unzip the mod, Find your mods folder, navigate to [CP] Isla>assets>Image, at this point, drop my portrait folder in and overwrite the original portrait folder to install the new art. 

Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/92602143]PaperNautilus[/url] for Isla and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for their incredibly inspirational art~ 

& Thanks reader for being interested in my very first mod!
